span.p:
Global Database
((Primary - US-East))
Reads: local (1-5ms)
Writes: local + async replication (50-500ms)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
Cache strategy: "Local read, global write"
- Writes go to the local primary (fast for the writer)
- Replicated asynchronously to other regions
- Other regions may serve stale data during replication lag
- TTL acts as the maximum staleness bound
